papers.title: ThinkBLOX
papers.bounded_finding: The existing method learns continuous think/answer placement sequences with token CE and separately adds tiered reward optimization. Its reasoning ablations do not establish that our two-call protocol has independent value. No weights, repository implementation, supplement or reported performance reproduced.

papers.title: Scene-Designer
papers.bounded_finding: The published method already trains observation-thought-action traces and ranks executed branches, comparing child scenes with their parent. A reason-first interface, tool feedback or branch selection alone is therefore not our distinct contribution. Its aggregate object-count reward is not equivalent to preserving a requested instance set. No new model inference or paper reproduction.
